RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

Sir,

I beg to report that enquiries have been made in vicinity of Hongkew Market & also Market place with a view to locating the person signing himself "Kau Kyung Dong", but without success. The C.D.C. referred to was questioned & he strongly denies the allegation, At the time & date mentioned the C.D.C. was at Headquarters Instruction class 3/4.10 p.m. & from 4.10/5 p.m. attended a bath house for a bath on Seward Road.

The place were the alleged robbery took place, simply states North Szechuen Road. This fact would tend to shew the report was false, no further letters have been received.

I am of the opinion that this letter was written by a person named Li, a friend of C.D.C.268 who has now left Shanghai. Since receiving this letter both these men, (C.D.Cs 216 & 268) have been reverted to uniform duty for Breach of disipline for an offence which was not connected with this letter but indirectly concerned the person suspected of writing this letter.

（批：* No 216.）

先生，

谨此报告，已在虹口市场及周边地区进行查访，以期找到自称“Kau Kyung Dong”之人，但未获成功。被提及的华籍探员（C.D.C.）已接受问询，他强烈否认该项指控。在上述提及的时间及日期，该华籍探员于下午4点10分在总部参加训导班课程，并于下午4点10分至5点在西华德路（Seward Road）的一家浴室洗澡。

所谓抢劫发生之地，仅称北四川路。这一事实倾向于表明该报告系虚假，此后未收到进一步信件。

我认为这封信是由一名姓李的人所写，此人是华籍探员268号的朋友，现已离开上海。自收到此信以来，这两名男子（华籍探员216号及268号）均因违纪行为被降回制服勤务岗位，该违纪行为虽与此信无直接关联，但间接涉及涉嫌撰写此信之人。

CONFIDENTIAL

Translation of a letter addressed to the President of the
Shanghai Special District Court from one Kau Ching Chong
aged 38, native of Chukiang, resident.

November 9, 1930.

Sir,

I beg to state that I came to Shanghai from Hangchow
to purchase goods. At 4 p.m. on 20-10/30 I was held up at
North Szechuen Road by one person in navy blue serge
lined long gown and several others in short clothing, all
armed, and was searched by them. They found in my
possession a sum of $674 and 6 dimes which they took away.
They threatened me by pointing a pistol at my breast and
warned me not to shout, otherwise they would beat me to
death. When they left, they again warned me not to report
the matter to the Police Station, or I would again be dealt
with severely. Being afraid I had to be patient and to keep
silent.

In the forenoon of 7th inst. accompanied by my friend
I went to the Hongkew Market where I saw the person who did
rob my money came out from the Hongkew Police Station. In
the meantime I intended to call a policeman to arrest him.
But being afraid of him I did not do what I intended to do.

As a result of my personal inquiry from different
sources yesterday, I learned that this person is a Chinese
detective attached to the Hongkew Police Station by the name
of Wong Nyok Zan (王玉朝 ) native of Wah-an, age about
50 years. With the power of a detective he was doing an
unlawful act. Therefore I beg to kindly respectfully that
you will go into the matter and give justice in the case.
I beg also to state that I have a family of several persons
to support and since my business capital was robbed I will
not be able to return home. If this case is not cleared out
the only thing I will do is to commit suicide by drowning
myself in the river.

Victim: Kau Ching Chong.

（左侧手写批注：）

机密

一封由38岁、浙江籍居民 Kau Ching Chong 致上海特区地方法院院长的信的译文。

1930年11月9日。

先生，

谨陈述，我从杭州来沪采购货物。1930年10月20日下午4时，我在北四川路被一名身穿藏青色哔叽衬里长衫的人及数名身穿短装的人拦下，这些人均持有武器，并对我进行了搜身。他们从我身上搜得674元及6角钱，并将其抢走。他们用枪指着我的胸口威胁我，警告我不许喊叫，否则会将我打死。他们离开时，再次警告我不准向巡捕房报案，否则将再次严厉处置我。因心生恐惧，我只能忍气吞声，保持沉默。

本月7日上午，我在朋友陪同下前往虹口市场，在那里我看到抢劫我钱财的那个人从虹口巡捕房出来。当时我本想叫警察逮捕他，但因害怕他而未敢实施原定计划。

由于昨日我个人通过多方渠道查询，得知此人是虹口巡捕房的一名华籍探员，名叫 Wong Nyok Zan（王玉朝），惠安人，年龄约50岁。他倚仗探员职权，从事非法活动。因此，恳请阁下对此事进行调查，并在本案中主持公道。我还须陈述，我有家眷数人需要供养，既然经商本金被抢，我将无法返乡。若此案不能查明，我唯有投河自尽。

受害人：Kau Ching Chong。

（左侧手写批注：）
C
8/10
已受理！

Translation of a letter from Kao Ching Chong (no address).

November 9, 1930.

Headquarters,
Crime & Special Branches,
Central Police Station.

Gentlemen,

I beg to state that I, Kao Ching Chong, age 38,
a native of Chekiang and a merchant, came to Shanghai from
Hangchow to purchase a quantity of goods.

At 4 p.m. on October 29 at North Szechuen Road
I was confronted with a number of men wearing either blue
serge long gowns or jackets, all armed with pistols. These
men searched me all over and relieved me of $674.60, which
money I brought for the purchase of goods, intimidating me
into silence by pointing a pistol at my breast and threatening
to deal with me by drastic measures in case should I dare to
make a report to the Police Station. In consequence I was
too afraid to report the matter to the Police.

In the morning of the 7th of the present month
I went with a friend to the Hongkew Market where I saw one
of the men who robbed me of my money come out of the Hongkew
Police Station. I would have called a policeman to have the
man arrested but for the fear of further trouble. After
careful enquiries I learned that the man was a native of
Huei-an, age about 30, Wong Nyoh Chao by name and a detective
of the Hongkew Police Station, who on reliance of his influence
as a detective, is engaged in all sorts of unlawful activities.

I have therefore to beseech you, Sir, D.C. (C. & S.B.),
to have my grievance redressed, for with my capital upon which
my family and myself depend for our living robbed, I am unable
to return home and have no other way but to end my life by
drowning in the Whangpoo River.

Kao Ching Chong.

Kao Ching Chong（无地址）来信译文。

1930年11月9日。

总部，
刑事与特别股，
中央巡捕房。

诸位先生，

谨陈述，本人 Kao Ching Chong，38岁，浙江籍商人，从杭州来沪采购一批货物。

10月29日下午4时，在北四川路，我遭遇一群身穿蓝色哔叽长衫或夹克的人，这些人均手持手枪。这些人对我全身搜查，抢走了我用于购货的674.60元，并用枪指着我的胸口恐吓我不许声张，威胁说若我胆敢向巡捕房报案，将采取严厉手段对付我。因此，我因极度恐惧而不敢向警方报案。

本月7日上午，我与一位朋友前往虹口市场，在那里我看到抢劫我钱财的那群人中的一人从虹口巡捕房出来。我本欲叫警察将该人逮捕，但因惧怕后续麻烦而未敢行动。经仔细查访，我得知此人名叫 Wong Nyoh Chao，惠安人，年龄约30岁，系虹口巡捕房的一名探员，他倚仗其作为探员的势力，从事各种非法活动。

因此，恳请刑事与特别股副总监先生为我伸冤，鉴于我赖以维持全家生计的本钱被抢，我无法返乡，除投黄浦江自尽外，别无他法。

Kao Ching Chong。
